mainEntity.name: What is the difference between SEO and AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) optimises your site to rank on traditional search engines like Google and Bing — using keywords, backlinks, and technical signals. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) optimises your content to be cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. SEO earns clicks from search results. AEO earns mentions inside AI-generated answers. In 2026, both matter — and they share the same technical foundation: structured data, clear entity signals, and authoritative content.

mainEntity.name: How long until I see SEO results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Technical SEO improvements (Core Web Vitals, indexing, schema) show up within 2 to 6 weeks once Google re-crawls. Ranking improvements for competitive keywords typically take 3 to 6 months of consistent content and technical work. AEO results are faster — AI systems update their training and retrieval pipelines more frequently, so well-structured content can start being cited within weeks. Swiss markets tend to be less saturated than English-speaking ones, which helps.

Yes — though it's still a young discipline. Tools like Otterly, Profound, and Peec AI track brand mentions across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. You can also monitor referral traffic from AI platforms in GA4, track branded search volume growth (a downstream AEO signal), and audit specific queries manually. I set up measurement frameworks at the start of every engagement so we know what's moving — and what isn't.
